instruction: Redis SINTER intersection of multiple sets
Redis SUNION union of multiple sets
Redis SDIFF difference of sets
Redis SCARD cardinality of set
Redis SPOP remove and return random member from set
Redis SRANDMEMBER get random set member without removal
Redis ZREM remove member from sorted set
Redis ZCARD cardinality of sorted set
Redis ZCOUNT count members in score range
Redis ZSCORE get score of member in sorted set
Redis ZINCRBY increment score in sorted set
Redis ZRANGEBYSCORE query sorted set by score
Redis ZREMRANGEBYSCORE remove by score range
Redis ZREMRANGEBYRANK remove by rank range
Redis ZRANK get rank of member (low to high)
Redis ZREVRANK get rank of member (high to low)
Redis GEOADD add geospatial point
Redis GEODIST distance between geospatial points
Redis GEORADIUS query geospatial by radius
output: redis-cli GEORADIUS locations 15 37 100 km WITHCOORD WITHDIST

instruction: Redis GEOPOS get position of geospatial member
Redis XADD add entry to stream
Redis XRANGE read stream entries by range
Redis XREAD read from stream with block
Redis XLEN stream length
Redis XGROUP create consumer group
output: redis-cli XGROUP CREATE sensor:temp mygroup $ MKSTREAM
